description: Request to create a secret to be mounted in a container.
doc: Datastream instructing the device to create a secret and configure how it is mounted within the container. The ttl of this datastream is short to keep the sensitive fields private.

mappings.description: Reference to a Deployment using the secret
mappings.doc: The deployment in which the secret is used, so the device can send deployment events to Astarte for the create request.
The raw binary content of the secret.
